eventLocation: Vegavathi River, near Pachaiyappa's College in Kanchipuram.
eventName: 6th Annual One Lakh Palm Seeds Plantation Festival ? 5th Phase Plantation Drive
eventDescription:
More than 10,000 palm seeds were planted along the banks of the Vegavathi River, near Pachaiyappa's College in Kanchipuram.
The event was graced by special guests Mr. Pachaiyappan Prabhu (Pachaiyappas Silks) and Rtn. Murugesh (Jyothi Residency), who participated and encouraged the initiative.
Students from Rasi College, APJS College of Arts, and St. Mary's College of Allied Health Sciences actively participated in this plantation drive. Golden Hearts Lions Club, Annachathiram, Kanchi Siragugal, and several other organizations and volunteers also joined hands to make this initiative a success.
